notes.title: Viking Frontiers: Prologue Playtest Hotfix 1.1.0p
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, warriors! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
A heartfelt thank you to all those who chose to try out the Viking Frontiers: Prologue Playest version! Thanks to your reports, suggestions and valuable feedback, our team was able to prepare [b]the first Hotfix,[/b] which addresses several important issues that you Vikings told us about.

Please know that each of your reports and ideas is carefully analyzed by our team, so we will be grateful for every piece of information you decide to share with us. The fastest and most convenient way to provide us with your opinion is to use this 👉 [url=https://forms.gle/DzAnif887ZMLLtcPA][b]dedicated Feedback Form.[/b][/url]

notes.title: Open World Survival Crafting Fest and new Demo 🤓
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, mighty Vikings! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
There are many terms that can describe the content of our beloved Viking Frontiers project. Open world? For sure! Survival? Check. Crafting? Yep! [b]Our game appears to be a perfect fit[/b] for the brand-new Steam event, the launch of which we are celebrating today...

Behold, Jarls! We are happy to announce, that [b]Viking Frontiers is taking part in the Steam Open World Survival Crafting Fest[/b] 🤩 And that means lots of exciting news and updates!


[h2]Join us in the Fest and try the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304430/Viking_Frontiers/]Demo[/url]![/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/4661da076e1195440a4503473250098b34c5ba59.png[/img]


[h2]New Demo - new features and content[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The last time you had the opportunity to visit the northern lands of Viking Frontiers [b]was over 3 months ago. [/b]And a lot has changed since then! ⚒️ The demo we have prepared on the occasion of Steam Survival Fest is definitely different from the one you remember from the beginning of the year. And it's not just about a new map or additional features! 


[h3]In addition to what you experienced in the first Demo, you can expect:[/h3]

• New map and new plot line
• Settler needs system  
• Better settlers AI and behaviors
• Animals and hunting system
• Raid system allowing you to attack other clans (*early version)
• Assigning your own house
• Improvements to production system
• Numerous adjustments, fixes and improvements

As you can see, there are many new challenges ahead. But along with the tough challenges comes the chance to [b]become the most glorious Viking in history! [/b]📜 Don't let this unique event pass you by, wishlist Viking Frontiers now and try your hand as a Norse ruler in the Open World Survival Crafting Fest Demo version of the game! 


[h2]Don't forget to share your [url=https://forms.gle/CYxA6FCnh3WPdVM89]feedback[/url][/h2]
[hr][/hr]
One of the main goals of launching the new Demo is to collect your [b]honest feedback, interesting ideas and insightful suggestions[/b]. As always, you can share them via our [b][url=https://discord.gg/GnTYDgBAHy]Discord server [/url][/b], Social Media channels or the 👉 [b][url=https://forms.gle/CYxA6FCnh3WPdVM89]Dedicated Feedback Form [/url][/b]. We are always happy to see your comments and opinions, so we will be very grateful for your help, everyone! 

It's time to discover the unknown. [b]Establish a new foothold[/b] in wild, dangerous lands. To lead your people to safety and honor. To collect, craft, build, trade and make fateful decisions. But remember... other Jarls will not remain indifferent to your[b] increase in power![/b] Looks like you need to send them a message ⚔️✊ 



[h3]Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️[/h3]

notes.title: 🔴 Viking Frontiers Demo Gameplay Stream - Watch and Play Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Greeting, mighty Jarls! ✊[/h1]

Embark on an incredibly immersive journey through the hostile yet breathtaking Nordic lands and join us in the Viking Frontiers Demo Gameplay Stream 🎥🔴 - NOW WITH THE NEW CONTENT

Find out what challenges await you as the leader of the newborn Viking society and work your way to becoming the greatest Jarl in history!

To play the demo version, please visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304430/Viking_Frontiers/][b]Viking Frontiers Steam[/b][/url] page and look for the Demo section. Any player who wishes to do so can freely play the Demo version and try their hand as a mighty Nordic ruler.

[hr][/hr]

We plan to add tons of new systems, features, tools, buildings, options and mechanics, so we look to the future with great excitement.

• a compass that will assist you in navigating the in-game world

• a short intro to welcome you to the game
• numerous fixes and minor improvements

[h3]Stay tuned![/h3]

In case of any questions or ideas, we remain at your disposal on Steam Discussions, Social Media channels and our [url=https://discord.gg/2SNTHtFQtF]Discord server[/url]. Be sure to drop by!

notes.title: The first Playtest Hotfix is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, mighty Vikings! ✊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Well, we can say with full confidence that... [b]you did it again![/b] 😁 You responded in great numbers, and thousands of you applied to our first Viking Frontiers Playtest. We are thrilled that our title has sparked so much interest in you all and that you want to try your hand at leading the newborn Viking society. Remember that the Jarl's burden is heavy, and the fate of your people will depend on your decisions and actions... however, [b]let us get back to the point.[/b]

Thanks to our own observations and, above all, your awesome feedback, we were able to prepare the[b] first Hotfix for the game[/b] ([b]more[/b] of them will come soon!) ⚒️ If you want to find out what fixes, improvements, quality of life changes and corrections we have made, be sure to check out the [b]Hotfix Notes[/b] down below 👇


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37681103/d1038f96dcb57b49dd01c15ebc41fb1d0b67f7a4.png[/img]


[h2]What's new in the Hotfix? 🤓[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
• Incorporated a verification process to ensure that the task has not been previously completed
• Improved animations of Workstation 
• Improved collision and interactivity of Workstations
• Added integrations with Steam. From now on, tabs will open in the Steam overlay, not in the browser
• Added a new UI panel for construction (build interaction)
• Added new key bind options (rotating construction previews)
• Added notification about the button to dump Large Resource
• Fixed the issue of falling to the bottom of the lake
• Improved balance of building schematics and construction elements
• Added an option to lock items in the Radial Menu panel so that they unlock as the tutorial progresses
• Added a button to unlock characters
• Added a number of new icons
• A number of bug fixes related to objects and collisions in the game
• A number of other minor bugs are now fixed


[h3]Thank you, testers![/h3]
[hr][/hr]
You can share your feedback via our [url=https://discord.gg/Mw8bvbzzJK ][b]Discord server [/b][/url]and the dedicated [url=https://forms.gle/g6aRhzYMGMPGmgXKA][b]Playtest Feedback Form[/b][/url]. Every, even the shortest, opinion is important to us, so we will [b]greatly appreciate[/b] it if you would like to share your feelings about the game!

In case of any questions or ideas, we remain at your disposal on Steam Discussions, Social Media channels and our Discord server. Be sure to drop by!

[b]Thank you, Vikings! Until next time! 🖐️[/b]



[h3]Have you seen our other games?[/h3]
